test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of height 14 cm is 176 cm². What is the area (in cm²) of the base of the cylinder? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Formula: **

Curved Surface Area, CSA = 2πrh unit

Area of the base = πr2 units

Wherea, R is radius of the base, r = radius of cylinder,

h = height of cylinder

Calculation:

According to the question,

⇒ 2 × (22)/(7) × r × 14 = 176

⇒ r = (176 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 14) = 2 cm.

Now, Area of the base = (22)/(7) × 2 × 2 = (88)/(7) cm2. 

∴ The Area of the base of the cylinder is (88)/(7) cm2
